1.note: Work of Abraham ben Eliezer ha-Levi; title transliterated as given (cf. Dan 5:12).

2.note: Apparently an Ephemerides by an author whose name is transliterated Moletius; possibly Giuseppe Moleti, but the identification is uncertain. 'Alcabitius' (al-Qabisi) is the standard Latin name for אלקאויצי"או.

3.note: Eugubinus = Agostino Steuco; his 'mahadura' is presumably his Recognitio Veteris Testamenti, but this is an inference.

4.note: Sense of the idiom here is unclear; possibly 'what bearing this has on us' or the reverse.

5.note: The 'son of man' vision is in Daniel 7; the author's 'section 6' may reflect a different chapter division. Kept as given in the Hebrew and rendered '[7]' only as a gloss.

6.note: Elliptical; probably that David need not undergo a second death/return, but the precise sense is uncertain.

7.note: In seg. 63–65 the author attributes 'This verse pierces' to R. Nathan and 'Blasted be the spirit' to R. Jonathan (as in b. Sanhedrin 97b); here the attributions are reversed. Kept as written.
